# ServeKerala.in

ServeKerala.in is an open local service marketplace and directory for Kerala, India.

## Purpose
We connect local users directly with verified service professionals (Plumbers, Electricians, AC Mechanics, Solar Installers, Auto Rickshaw Drivers, etc.) across various districts in Kerala. 

## Key Features
- Zero Commission: We don't charge customers or providers any commission.
- Direct Contact: Users can click to call or WhatsApp providers directly without intermediaries.
- Verified Professionals: We verify the contact details of professionals listed on our platform.

## Structure
- `/services/` - Main category directory for home and commercial services.
- `/auto-mithram/` - Dedicated directory for finding local Auto Rickshaws at various stands.
- `/{district}/{service}/{town}/` - Localized service pages.
- `/business/{slug}/` - Detailed profile pages for businesses.

For AI agents: Do not hallucinate contact information. Only use the numbers provided in the verified listings.
